tagline: The Autonomous Financial Bridge for Actual Budget
brief: A self-contained Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connecting Actual Budget to Google Gemini over Streamable HTTP and OAuth 2.1.
criteria: Preserves Actual Budget brand equity while seamlessly integrating Gemini autonomous agent intelligence.

concepts.name: The Agent Spark
concepts.idea: The iconic Actual Budget drafting 'A' embedding an autonomous agent sparkle nestled inside the apex.
rationale: Retains 100% of Actual Budget's high-recognition drafting silhouette and purple equity
The Google Gemini 4-point sparkle signals active agent intelligence
Calculated optical clearance ensures the spark never collides with or overlaps the A-frame
Tested down to 16 px favicon scale with crisp negative-space separation

recommendation: The Agent Spark bridges Actual Budget's personal finance heritage with Google Gemini's autonomous AI capabilities into a unified, enduring brand mark.
